runtime.listControls: allowedAuthorNames and blockedAuthorNames use exact case-insensitive matching; blockedBodyPhrases and blockedUserAgentPhrases use bounded substring matching
runtime.accessIntegration: comment list/count/create/hide require readable content when content.access is enabled
runtime.adminListLimit: admin audit and notification lists clamp request limit by maxAdminListRows
runtime.adminAuditWorkbench: ability page exposes a dedicated moderation queue, audit logs filtered by commentId, notification logs and bounded batch approve/reject
runtime.adminModerationQueue: comment.moderation-queue returns pending comments with content title, author/IP, bodyLength, linkCount, riskScore, riskFlags, ageSeconds, audit counts and optional contentId/authorName/body/ip filters under maxAdminListRows
runtime.adminModerationRisk: riskScore and riskFlags are admin-only diagnostics derived from existing anti-spam config; they do not change public submit behavior
runtime.adminModerationStats: comment.moderation-stats returns pending/approved/rejected/hidden/deleted totals for the manual moderation workbench
runtime.adminModerationRiskStats: comment.moderation-stats scans the bounded pending moderation queue and returns riskStats buckets without changing public submit behavior
runtime.adminModerationStatsUi: ability page renders moderation totals and the recent pending window as a table, while retaining raw JSON for diagnostics
runtime.adminBatchModerationUi: ability page renders comment.status-batch as a bounded summary and per-comment result table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.adminAuditFilters: audit logs support optional commentId/action filters and notification logs support optional commentId/contentId/status/event filters with bound SQL
runtime.adminBatchModeration: comment.status-batch accepts a bounded ids array and only supports approve/reject status changes
runtime.adminStatusValidation: comment.status only accepts pending(0), approve(1) or reject(2) status values
runtime.adminRequestLimit: admin comment status/delete reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
